    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"file\":\"eyJwcm9tcHQiOiAiaGVsbG8ifQo=\",\"filename\":\"training_data.jsonl\",\"purpose\":\"fine-tune\"}", CreateFileRequest::class.java)
